title: Estrada: cotton joints and cyanoacrylate glue

tellings.quote: They use cyanoacrylate, and it gives it quite an interesting hardness, right?

plain: Small three-fingered bodies from Peru, presented by some as alien, were reportedly put together with cotton at the joints and held with cyanoacrylate, the chemical in super glue, which made them unusually hard. A researcher named Flavio Estrada says this from his own study of the figures, without naming another source. If true, it would mean the bodies were made by people.
